source: Operator reported ISO mounted and controller disconnected. Direct WinDbg MCP inspection after breaking the running guest.
context: Follow-up to vm-queue-corrected-reuse-20261029.json, before a fresh uncorrected performance run
limitations: The file-handle owner was not identified; only the previously observed GameInput worker's file handles were searched.
The object header pointer count is reported literally; it is not used as an exact outstanding I/O or reference-lifetime measurement.
A disconnected controller does not establish that all former device objects and queues were destroyed.
No handles were forcibly closed and no services or power settings were changed.
A later reconnect must independently establish a new device context, present interface routing and queue-list baseline. Retired-device residency remains a possible comparison confound.
This observation does not establish a new defect, leak or causal connection to the reported game FPS loss.
